objective: Implement deterministic scenario engine fault timing activation, sensor-freeze sample retention, hardware pump fault targeting, and structured scenario file validation in hydragrow-simulator.

acceptance.criterion: ScenarioEngine activates fault events exactly once when simulated time window crosses at_ms.
Injector sensor-freeze fault retains the initial sample value across subsequent sensor readings.
Injector supports hardware pump faults across all supported pump targets.
Scenario validation rejects invalid pump or sensor target names with structured error message.
Simulator code passes cargo fmt, cargo check, clippy with warnings as errors, and tests.
acceptance.verification: cargo test -p hydragrow-simulator && cargo fmt --check --manifest-path hydragrow-simulator/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path hydragrow-simulator/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
